concept.title: Scene Collections and Profiles
concept.shortdesc: Two independent ways to save and switch entire setups at once.

conbody.p: A scene collection is the full set of scenes and sources you've built. A profile is a full set of output, audio, and video settings. They're independent: you can pair any scene collection with any profile, which is useful when the same scenes need different output settings depending on where you're streaming from.
Both are managed from their respective menus, support duplicating an existing one as a starting point, and can be exported to a file and imported on another machine.
